note: KDWP state fishing lake and wildlife area a few miles northwest of Topeka. Primitive camping in designated areas only, none on the west side of the lake; picnic tables, campfires in the metal rings only. No alcohol; pack out all trash. --Claude
summary: KDWP Shawnee page (Wayback 2026-04-22): designated primitive camping (none on the west side), three vault toilets, no electricity or running water; free/FCFS, 7-night limit (K.A.R.). max_stay 7, vault toilets, no potable water added; fees/booking/hookups re-sourced. Lake ~116-127 acres. Pin sits on the dam face in the water -> move proposed. Not waterfront kept. Phone missing -> (785) 887-6882.
flags: PIN 39.2003,-95.8036 is on the lake side of the dam crest, in the water (Esri frame), not on a camping area. KDWP doesn't map the designated camping areas for Shawnee (no 'Areas' list on its page, brochure unread). Camping is banned on the west side, so the areas are on the east shore, which has a shoreline road with turnouts and vault toilets at the south-east (by the dam's east end, 39.20146,-95.80024) and the north-east (39.20976,-95.80255, beside the boat ramp; Google's point 39.20825,-95.80237 is there too). Propose 39.2015,-95.8012 (the south-east shore turnouts west of the SE vault toilet, ~250 m from the stored pin); I can't see marked pads at either end, so this is the nearest use area, not a measured site centre. The NE ramp area (39.2085,-95.8030) is the alternative if AWH prefers Google's point.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' kept: the designated sites aren't identified, so nothing can be earned. Lead: the east-shore road and its turnouts run 10-40 m from the water on open grass with a scattered tree fringe; if the camp areas are those turnouts, lakeview is likely (the road sits between most of them and the shore, which blocks on-water). Lake ~116 acres (KDWP water-body polygon, Mercator-corrected) / 127 acres (OSM) - well over the 5-acre pond line; full on Esri imagery.

PHONE missing (apply.py doesn't write it): propose (785) 887-6882 (the area's phone on the KDWP page); the manager Stephen Anderson is (785) 600-8818. Google still lists 913-845-2665 and an old kdwp.state.ks.us link.
